title: Mouse Sleep Staging Validation dataset (MSSV)
description: This dataset comprises EEG and EMG recordings with expert-annotated sleep scores from 92 healthy mice, collected across five research laboratories in Italy, Denmark, Switzerland, and France. Recordings span both dark and light phases and were standardized to 128Hz sampling with SI units, aiming to validate automated mouse sleep staging methods. The dataset is formatted in BIDS and stored in EDF format.
methods_description: Recordings were collected from 92 healthy mice across five labs, each scored by a single sleep expert. All recordings contain at least one EEG and one EMG channel, with the number of EEG channels varying by lab. Data were downsampled to 128Hz with SI units (volts), using an epoch length of 4 seconds.
